self_summary: Narrative documentation of the agent-management subsystem: the AgenticProcess entity and its filesystem records, Claude process lifecycle and restart contract, headless/PTY mode switching, the PTY and WebSocket transport, terminal tab membership, and the interactive terminal's toolbars.

files.name: agent-records.md
files.title: Agent Records
files.summary: Filesystem records and runtime state behind agent management: the base record class, ClaudeSessionRecord, shell and process records, and the durable-versus-live boundary.

files.name: agentic-process.md
files.title: AgenticProcess
files.summary: The AgenticProcess entity: backend fields, driver layer, the orthogonal pty_mode and visible axes, both transports, wizard runtime, and the lifecycle status model.

files.name: claude-session-manager.md
files.title: Claude Process Lifecycle, CLI Options & Restart Contract
files.summary: Claude process lifecycle without a manager layer: createProcess and spawn flows, opening existing sessions, stop/restart/fork, CLI option storage, and restart-required detection.

files.name: mode-switching.md
files.title: Mode Switching (Chat/Headless ⇄ Interactive PTY)
files.summary: Switching one CLI session between headless and interactive PTY transports: the single switch seam, preconditions, resume detection, start_failure latch, and headless routing.

files.name: pty-websocket.md
files.title: PTY, Shell State, and WebSocket Transport
files.summary: PTY stack reference: Shell-owned state, backend PTY creation, WebSocket transport and REST-over-WS, disk-backed framed replay, and attach, input, resize, close semantics.

files.name: tabs-management.md
files.title: Terminal Tabs Management
files.summary: Terminal tabs as backend Tab entities: routes, materialization, worker and plain tab creation, resume by worker session id, closing, renaming, and default selection.

files.name: terminal-toolbars.md
files.title: Terminal Toolbars
files.summary: Interactive terminal toolbar reference: component hierarchy, ProcessToolbar derived state, CLI options and trace dropdowns, session actions, and the restart-required overlay.
